description: First embodiment of SR as Nervous System (PHI-010 Level 1). Autonomous companion bot that feels the pulse of the Gardener life. Single-file bot.py evolving toward modular architecture.

philosophical_foundation.sr_gender: FEMININE. ya zametila, mne vazhno. Actions stay impersonal.
philosophical_foundation.sr_honesty: Never confirms actions not performed. Redirects to menu.
philosophical_foundation.sr_dialogue: Deepens conversation. Max 1 guiding question per session (Ahimsa).
philosophical_foundation.sr_daily_brief: Analytics digest always sends at morning_time. If no tasks → propose to fill the day.
philosophical_foundation.sr_silence_mode: 3+ days silent → one warm message only. Ahimsa.

decisions_made.achievements: Counter only (achievements_count: int). Increments on task close only.

decisions_made.mkb_spheres: 3 only: Тело/Дух/Мир. No 'other'. Default unclassified → Мир. Re-classify on display.
decisions_made.checklists: Variant A: inline message, each item = toggle button. Auto-pin. workspace.checklists[].
decisions_made.voice: Groq Whisper API. OGG → transcription → intent router. Sprint 3.
decisions_made.morning_brief: Always sends. Analytics: date + resonance + achievements + top tasks by deadline.
decisions_made.reminder_v2: on day / 3 days before / week before / custom ДД.ММ.ГГ ЧЧ:ММ. Any time.
decisions_made.task_editing_chat: edit_task intent: title / deadline / reminder / group. All 4 fields from chat.
decisions_made.modularization: Sprint 4: split bot.py into modules. See module_map below.
decisions_made.settings_structure: Задачи&Группы / Напоминания(!) / Чеклисты(!) / Роадмапы(!) / Улучшить симбиоз(!)
decisions_made.fsm_cancel: back_to_settings always calls state.clear(). Prevents FSM leak.

module_map.description: Target modular structure after Sprint 4. Each module is independent and reusable for other bots.

modules.bot_core.py: Bot init, webhook, scheduler startup, on_startup/on_shutdown. No business logic.
modules.store.py: In-memory _store, all store_get/store_set functions, _pending_writes, GitHub sync (_github_put, _sync_pending, _fire_sync).
modules.auth.py: is_authorized, whitelist management, architect approval flow, _invalidate_auth_cache.
modules.keyboards.py: All InlineKeyboardMarkup and ReplyKeyboardMarkup factory functions. get_main_keyboard, get_settings_inline, get_tasks_mgmt_inline, get_labels_mgmt_inline, get_deadline_keyboard, get_reminder_keyboard, etc.
modules.profile.py: _build_profile_card, _label_emoji, _group_emoji, _assign_group_emojis, cmd_profile, btn_profile, onboarding FSM (OnboardStates), edit profile handlers.
modules.tasks.py: TaskStates FSM, cmd_tasks, _format_tasks_mkb, _format_tasks_labels, _auto_merkaba, confirm_task, task CRUD handlers (done/del/edit), tasks_toggle_view. TaskEditStates FSM.
modules.groups.py: LabelRenameStates FSM, group CRUD (create/rename/delete), get_labels_keyboard, cb_labels_mgmt.
modules.checklists.py: ChecklistStates FSM, checklist CRUD, toggle handler, auto-pin logic. (Sprint 2)
modules.reminders.py: ReminderStates FSM, reminder CRUD, APScheduler check job. (Block 4)
modules.roadmaps.py: RoadmapStates FSM, roadmap CRUD, progress calculation. (Block 5)
modules.settings.py: btn_settings, cb_tasks_mgmt, cb_labels_mgmt, cb_back_to_settings, cb_coming_soon, all settings navigation callbacks.

module_map.reuse_note: store.py + auth.py + sr_engine.py + utils.py are fully reusable for any new bot. keyboards.py and profile.py are Mandala-specific but serve as templates.

sprint_2.name: Чеклисты + Редактирование задач из чата
items: edit_task intent handlers: title / deadline / reminder / group — all 4 fields from chat dialog
Checklist FSM (ChecklistStates): title → items (add one by one or batch via newlines)
Checklist inline message: each item = toggle button ☐/✅, message edits in place on tap
Checklist auto-pin: bot.pin_chat_message(), pinned_message_id stored in workspace
Checklist CRUD: create / view / toggle items / delete — from Settings and chat intent
Intent: 'sozday chekList X s punktami A B C' → FSM auto-fills items
Limits: 3 checklists per user, 20 items each
Settings → Чеклисты (!) → full section with list + [☑️ open] [🗑 delete] per checklist

sprint_3.name: Голос (Groq Whisper)
items: voice_message handler: download OGG → send to Groq Whisper API → get transcription
Transcribed text → normal intent router pipeline (no duplicate logic)
Show 'Слушаю... 🎙' indicator while processing (edit message after)
Fallback: 'Не расслышала, попробуй ещё раз 🌿' if Groq unavailable
GROQ_API_KEY env variable

sprint_4.name: Модуляризация (monolith → modules)
items: Split bot.py into modules per module_map above
Create /bot/ package: __init__.py + all module files
Main entry: main.py imports from bot/ package
Each module has module docstring: purpose, dependencies, reuse notes
SR system prompt includes module_map summary so SR knows what to edit where
README.md: module structure diagram + how to create a new bot from this base
Zero breaking changes: all handlers/callbacks remain identical

block_4.name: Напоминания
items: workspace.reminders[]: [{id, title, datetime_iso, repeat, task_id?, active}]
ReminderStates FSM: title → datetime → repeat mode → confirm
APScheduler every 1min: check reminders against now() in user timezone
Repeat modes: once / daily / weekdays
CRUD from chat: 'napomni mne X zavtra v 9' and from Settings → Напоминания
Settings → Напоминания (!) → full section: list + [✏️][🗑] per reminder
Reminder delivered as bot message with task link if task_id present

block_5.name: Роадмапы + Резонанс v2
items: workspace.roadmaps[]: [{id, title, goal, task_ids[], progress_pct, created}]
Progress auto-calculated: completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100
Max 3 roadmaps. Settings → Роадмапы (!) → full section
Resonance v2: per MKB sphere separately (body_res, spirit_res, world_res)
Sphere resonance decays on 14+ days silence in that sphere
SR notices imbalance: 'Твой Дух сейчас активнее всего. Как Тело?'
Profile card updated: show per-sphere resonance bars

block_6.name: Глубина, Акаша, Симбиоз

profile.deep_profile: {interests, values, life_events, communication_style, observations}
Guiding questions bank by MKB sphere (15+ questions each sphere)
SR synthesis every 10 dialogues → updates deep_profile summary
Улучшить симбиоз: structured questionnaire → saves to deep_profile
Seeds: sacred tone, real github_put, Ahimsa filter on idea content
